t: You're at St Dunstan's, an Anglican church on Stepney High Street in Stepney. It's believed to have been founded, or re-founded, in AD 952 by St Dunstan, the patron saint of bell ringers, metalworkers and Stepney. Several people are buried here, including a number of bishops. Marmaduke Lumley was Bishop of Carlisle in the fifteenth century and later Lord High Treasurer of England. Mark Hodson and Brian Masters were twentieth-century bishops, Masters of Fulham and then Edmonton. The shipowner and Conservative politician Joseph Somes is buried here too.
